user.title: Sungrow inverter
user.description: The dongle's Modbus port is encrypted by the inverter itself and needs no login. The rule is switched on later with the 'Curtail on negative price' switch.

data.trigger_price: Curtail when the price is below
data.min_sun_elevation: Stop curtailing below this sun elevation

data_description.price_entity: The sensor holding the price you are paid to export. A negative value means you pay to export.
data_description.trigger_price: In the sensor's own unit. 0 means curtail only when the price is negative.
data_description.curtail_kw: 0 stops export entirely. Must be below the limit used otherwise.
data_description.full_kw: Leave empty to use the inverter's rated power.
data_description.min_sun_elevation: Restores full export before the light ends and the dongle powers off.
data_description.restore_after_minutes: A curtailed limit lapses back by itself unless the rule renews it.
data_description.min_interval_seconds: Stops the limit flapping on a noisy price.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the inverter through the dongle.
error.curtail_not_below_full: The curtailed limit must be below the limit used otherwise.

abort.already_configured: This dongle is already set up.
